texts.title: At the hotel
texts.text: Good evening! I have a reservation. My name is Anna Petrova. — Good evening! Yes, a double room for three nights. Breakfast is included. It is from seven to ten in the restaurant. Here is your key. Your room is on the second floor. — Thank you! Is there Wi-Fi? — Yes, the password is on the card. Have a nice stay!
